title: Writing-template registry (capability write-platform)
description: Index of structure templates the writer can follow (--template=<id>). Templates are COMMITTED markdown skeletons under 06-ai-ops/write/templates/<category>/<id>.md, organized in category subfolders. File-existence is enforced by scripts/cross-tier/validate-write-registries.cjs.

id.description: Unique slug; the value passed to --template=<id> (a bare name resolves through the registry; a path is also accepted by --template=).

applies_to_types.description: write-types ids this template fits well (advisory).
